claim: HA community (June 2024): notify entities (including MQTT notify) could not be used as the legacy alert integration's notifier; the workaround was a command-line notifier hitting a webhook automation — so legacy notify-SERVICE consumers cannot target entity-platform notifiers directly.
stance_target: adopt-vs-build nuance: MQTT notify entities integrate via notify.send_message + entity_id targeting; legacy integrations expecting old notify services don't see them
scope_conditions: HA 2024.6-era; alert integration; notify entity model
quoted_support: I want to use the MQTT Notify platform as a notifier of an alert. I understand that we are migrating towards entities and that not everything is there, yet, but I'd just want to confirm that you cannot use notify entities with alerts, yet.
